title: Ada Tours International Partners and Representatives
description: Ada Tours partners include JAN Tourism Consultancy, REPS Unlimited and Global Destinations. International representation and membership in ABAV-RJ.
eyebrow: From Rio de Janeiro to the world
lead: We design journeys from Rio de Janeiro and work with travel companies in overseas markets. Our representatives introduce Ada Tours to partners, while our team designs and coordinates the travel experience across Latin America.

sections.heading: International connections, a local team
paragraphsMarkdown: For a travel agency, getting to know a destination often begins with a conversation with a representative. Our partners present Ada Tours' capabilities in their markets and build professional relationships. Our network spans Benelux, the UAE, India, Germany and Russia.

We then focus on the trip itself: accommodation, transport, excursions and guests' preferences. The [Ada Tours team](/team/) handles [individual and group requests from agencies](/dmc/travel-agencies/), [VIP journeys](/vip/) and [business programs](/mice/) across Latin America.

sections.heading: Send us a brief we can work with
paragraphsMarkdown: For an initial proposal, share the dates, number of travelers, countries and must-see places, accommodation preferences and budget. For business travel or events, include the work schedule and assistance requirements.

We'll clarify the services and prepare an itinerary around your request. Commercial terms are agreed for each trip and explained further in our [terms of cooperation](/dmc/terms/). You can explore examples of our work on the ground in the [Ada Tours cases](/cases/).

sections.heading: Ada Tours and ABAV-RJ
paragraphsMarkdown: Ada Tours is a member of ABAV-RJ, the professional association of travel agencies in Rio de Janeiro.

ABAV-RJ is listed separately from our commercial partners: the association brings together travel-industry members, while JAN Tourism Consultancy, REPS Unlimited and Global Destinations help develop international cooperation.

sourcesIntro: Ada Tours works with representatives in overseas markets and an international network of DMC partners.

sourceEntries.title: JAN Tourism Consultancy
sourceEntries.annotationMarkdown: JAN Tourism Consultancy represents Ada Tours to travel companies in Benelux and the UAE. Its partner page covers destinations in Brazil and Latin America, travel materials and contact details for Anna Avanesova.
sourceEntries.linkLabel: Ada Tours at JAN Tourism Consultancy

sourceEntries.title: REPS Unlimited
sourceEntries.annotationMarkdown: Ada Tours appears in the REPS Unlimited DMC partner network as an inbound operator for Brazil and Latin America. The profile introduces agents to private, family and group travel, specialist programs and incentive trips.
sourceEntries.linkLabel: Ada Tours profile at REPS Unlimited

sourceEntries.title: Global Destinations
sourceEntries.annotationMarkdown: Global Destinations represents Ada Tours in India for sales and marketing. The partnership includes working with travel businesses, introducing partners to the product and supporting the planning of Latin American itineraries.
sourceEntries.linkLabel: Ada Tours among Global Destinations partners

sourceEntries.title: ABAV-RJ
sourceEntries.annotationMarkdown: The official ABAV-RJ directory lists Ada Tours as a current association member. Its profile includes the company's legal name, CNPJ and official website.

sourceEntries.title: Majunke International Sales
sourceEntries.annotationMarkdown: Ada Tours' German representation: a dedicated company page on Majunke International Sales and cooperation with travel agents and tour operators on Brazil and Latin America.
sourceEntries.linkLabel: Ada Tours at Majunke International Sales

sourceEntries.title: Unique Promotion
sourceEntries.annotationMarkdown: Ada Tours is listed among Unique Promotion's clients on the representative's official website. The company promotes hotels and inbound travel businesses in the Russian market.
sourceEntries.linkLabel: Ada Tours among Unique Promotion clients

faqHeading: Frequently asked questions about Ada Tours partners

faq.question: Which markets have Ada Tours representatives?
faq.answerMarkdown: JAN Tourism Consultancy represents Ada Tours in Benelux and the UAE, Global Destinations in India, and Majunke International Sales in Germany. In Russia, Ada Tours is listed among the clients of Unique Promotion. The company is also part of the REPS Unlimited DMC partner network.

faq.question: Who designs the itinerary and organizes the trip locally?
faq.answerMarkdown: Our [Ada Tours team](/team/) prepares journeys across Brazil and Latin America. We agree the itinerary and services, coordinating accommodation, transport, excursions and the other parts of the trip. Our [travel agents section](/dmc/travel-agencies/) explains how we work with partners.

faq.question: Can I contact Ada Tours directly?
faq.answerMarkdown: Yes. Use the form on this page or our [company contact details](/contacts/). For an initial quote, send the dates, countries, guest numbers, budget and accommodation preferences. If a representative or partner is already involved in your project, mention them in the inquiry.

faq.question: What is the relationship between Ada Tours and ABAV-RJ?
faq.answerMarkdown: Ada Tours is a member of ABAV-RJ, the professional association of travel agencies in Rio de Janeiro. The official directory hosts the company's membership profile; you can find its link in the membership section on this page.

finalCta.title: Let us welcome your guests in Latin America
finalCta.text: Tell us about your client, itinerary or business needs. We'll discuss the program, services and the most convenient way to cooperate.
